games.name: Horizon Blue: 1919
games.desc:
GAME IS IN ALPHA

The Horizon has never been so dull, a landscape shattered by years of relentless artillery and broken promises. Verdun, once again, becomes the forefront of the War. The German war machine thrusts inward into the ravaged citadel of France, seeking a final, decisive blow...

In The War That Ended All Wars, history fractures. Step into the muddied boots of weary yet unbroken infantrymen in a brutal, lengthy player-driven campaign. Will you push the offensive and carve a path through Verdun—or stand your ground as the fiercest bastion of Allied resistance against the German Army.

CONTROLS:
WASD - Move
L. CTRL - Mouse lock
QE - Switch Shoulder View
BV - Equip & Arm Bayonet
Tab F8 F10 - Scoreboard, Settings & Info
M1 M2 - Fire, Aim
M1 - While loop reloading: Cancel
R - Reload, Detonate
Z - Toggle aim
P - Mute Music

Desktop Recommended. Performances settings in F8 menu.
Credits in-game, in the Info menu.

For any further inquiries, do not hesitate to contact me directly !

games.name: UPDATE! Dynamic Ship Simulator III
games.desc:
Update 50 sets sail with something for everyone! Live it up aboard Superyacht Amaryllis, ride high seas on the Azerbaijan-class RO-PAX, or go back in time on the Julia Swain Paddlesteamer. Craving speed? Race the 50' & 42' Powerboats, 18' Drag Boat, or the sleek Stinger 390x. Also joining the fleet: the massive 5400 Series container ship and the Halifax-class frigate. Plus new terminals & marina at Nexo, terminal & shipyard at Ushuaia, shipyard at Ronne!

Welcome to the immense world of Dynamic Ship Simulator III! In this game, you can sail anything from a jetski all the way up to a massive Arctic-class LNG carrier. Engage in player-vs-player combat in your Visby-class Corvette, cruise around in your motorboat or transport cars in your European-class ferry. Be sure to watch for updates!

Some skins and passes can only be bought in-game!
